title: Always Up To Date --json output
description: The one JSON document `autd check --json`, `autd update --dry-run --json` and `autd update --json` print on stdout: a plan document with rows, or an error document. Within version 1, fields and reason codes may be added; consumers branch on `outcome`.

planDocument.description: The planned (or applied) rows of a run.

autd.description: The version of autd that printed the document.

command.description: The command that printed the document.

phase.description: "plan" for check and update --dry-run; "applied" once update has run, also when nothing moved.

manager.description: The package manager the run used.

member.description: The workspace member the run started from, relative to the workspace root; null outside a member run.

rows.description: One row per package and manifest, in the plan's order. Empty when nothing is outdated.

errorDocument.description: What a failed command prints; the exit code is 1.

autd.description: The version of autd that printed the document.

step.description: The pipeline step that failed; null for a failure outside a step, such as a malformed config.

manifestWritten.description: True when a package.json was already rewritten when the package manager failed; check it against the lockfile before committing.

name.description: The package name, as the manifest names it (an npm: alias keeps its key).

workspace.description: The manifest's directory relative to the project root; "." for the root and for a single-package project.

current.description: The installed version; null when the dependency is not installed.

wanted.description: The highest version the manifest's range allows.

target.description: The version the row moves to; null when it is held.

updateType.description: The semver step from current to the target (to latest when held); null when it cannot be derived.

outcome.description: "update": the row moves (or moved). "held": the plan leaves it, see reason. "not-applied": update ran, but the manager left it below its target. "not-targeted": left out because update named other packages.

warnings.description: Problems the row moved despite (a "latest" rule over a peer conflict); empty when there are none.

releaseAgeDays.description: The age in days of the release the cooldown judged; null when nothing judged the row.

reason.description: Why a row moves or is held.

code.description: A stable code. Moving: within-range, past-range, rule-latest, cooldown-fallback, engines-fallback. Held: invalid-version, not-installed, not-newer, rule-hold, rule-follow-range, outside-range, override, peer-conflict, target-peers, cooldown, deprecated, license-change, engines, held-with. After apply or not asked for: not-applied, not-targeted. Within version 1, codes may be added in 4.x without a version bump: branch on outcome, and treat an unknown code like its outcome.

message.description: The human-readable text, as the report shows it. Not stable; do not parse it.
